note: City pages. `aliases` are matched inside a firm's `city` string (a firm can belong to several cities); `regions` are matched inside a firm's or operator's `coverage` string, on top of the country-wide match. `nt_region` must equal a region in kalkulator.json -> eps.nt_hours. `loc` is the locative (u Beogradu), `acc` the accusative (izlazak u Suboticu) — both are needed because Serbian city names decline.

cities.name: Beograd
cities.note: Popusta na parking za električna vozila u zonama nema. Punjenje u garaži Obilićev venac ne naplaćuje se posebno, plaća se parking (tarifa iz 2021). Više: putarina i parking.

cities.name: Novi Sad
cities.note: Od jula 2026. parking na mestu sa javnim punjačem u Novom Sadu košta 500 RSD za 60 minuta, struja uključena. Više: putarina i parking.

cities.name: Kragujevac
cities.note: U Kragujevcu nijedna firma sa spiska nema sedište. Kad zovete firmu iz drugog grada, pitajte da li se izlazak na teren plaća posebno.
